name: sciwrite-proposals
description: Write the documents an academic career runs on besides papers: narrative review articles, grant and fellowship applications (specific aims, research plan), letters of recommendation, and personal statements. Based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever someone mentions writing or reviewing a grant, a fellowship application, a research proposal, a specific aims page, a research plan or strategy, a review article or literature review, a letter of recommendation or reference letter, a personal statement, a motivation letter, or an application essay for a PhD programme, postdoc, scholarship or residency. Also use it when someone asks how to ask for a recommendation letter, how to narrow a review topic, what reviewers of a fellowship are actually scored against, or how to respond to reviewers of a grant or fellowship application. Do NOT use it for research papers (sciwrite-manuscript) or for sentence-level editing alone (sciwrite-prose).
